High Court Reinstates Punjab Police Officer Dismissed Over Bishnoi Interview

The Punjab and Haryana High Court has quashed the dismissal of a Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) who was removed from service after interviewing gangster Lawrence Bishnoi in jail. The court found the dismissal order to be unsustainable and lacking in due process. The officer had conducted the interview, which was reportedly published, leading to his termination. The High Court's decision reinstates the DSP to his position.
